items.html: And when the Hochma spread, and the Bina was revealed, which is Ima, who was included in it — for then they gave birth to KHB, which are the fathers in ZA — then the Hochma is called 'Aba, the father of the fathers.' And know, that although they are the brain of ZA, and are called KHB to him, relative to AVI they are HGT, and they are literally the fathers; and as I intend to say below. And understand this. And this is what is said in the portion Mishpatim: 'the head of the King is corrected with Hesed and Gevura.' And that suffices.
